items.name: Deutsche Kreditbank AG (DKB)
items.notes: The HGB PDF is blocked (dok.dkb.de robots-disallowed; dok-cms.dkb.de mirror returned an error, as did ob_2025.pdf). The Lobbyregister copy (https://www.lobbyregister.bundestag.de/media/85/83/849142/gb_2025.pdf) is the IFRS Geschäftsbericht. Its HGB section (p. 38) is beyond the read limit. IFRS-Konzern for reference: Bilanzsumme 135.831 Mio. (2025) / 131.361 Mio. (2024), EK 6.958 / 6.548 Mio. Eulerpool shows the same IFRS data. Do not use these as HGB.

items.name: State Street Bank International GmbH
items.notes: Eulerpool gives only rounded values: 2023 Bilanzsumme 46,2 Mrd. EUR, EK 3,89 Mrd., Stammkapital 109,4 Mio. 2024 values are marked 'e' (statistical estimate: Bilanzsumme 48,2 Mrd.e) and not usable. No 2025 values. The Austrian EVI register (FN 237384w) has 'Jahresabschluss zum 31.12.2024' (https://www.evi.gv.at/b/pi/bml-5lp) and 31.12.2023 (https://evi.gv.at/b/pi/bl4-wxr) as PDFs, but no fetchable download link. Disclosure report SSEHG 31.12.2025 (HGB-based), KM1 for SSBI: CET1 3.621 Mio., total capital 3.729 Mio., leverage exposure 52.850 Mio. These are regulatory figures, not balance-sheet values. The fields stay null because only rounded or estimated figures are available.

items.notes: The HGB section (p. 114) lies beyond the extractable text (77k characters). Eulerpool data are IFRS and internally inconsistent: Aktiva 151 Mio., EK 3.957 Mio. (2025). Not usable. Only the IFRS Konzernbilanzsumme 28,6 (33,6) Mrd. is confirmed.

items.name: TARGOBANK AG
items.notes: FY2025 HGB not available on Eulerpool. The Jahresbericht 2025 has only IFRS group figures (Bilanzsumme 47,5 Mrd.). EK components sum correctly: gez. Kapital 264.884 T + Kapitalrücklage 2.337.521 T + Gewinnrücklagen 146.225 T = 2.748.630 T. JÜ is 0 because of the profit transfer. The values are 2024 with 2023 as prior year. Cross-check: the Offenlegungsbericht 31.12.2024 (group TDGmbH, HGB) shows LR1 total assets 44.858,95 Mio. and CC1 Fonds 1.135 Mio. This is a different consolidation scope than the AG.

items.name: Aareal Bank AG
items.source_doc: Geschäftsbericht Aareal Bank AG 2025 (HGB), Lagebericht S. 19 (Bilanzsumme), S. 21 (bilanzielles Eigenkapital)
items.notes: The Bilanzsumme is ROUNDED to 0,1 Mrd. ('51,8 Mrd. € ... nach 51,5 Mrd. €'). The exact value is in the Jahresbilanz on p. 64, beyond the read limit. The same file is in the Lobbyregister (https://www.lobbyregister.bundestag.de/media/00/7c/861322/2025-Jahresabschluss-Aareal-Bank-AG.pdf) and has the same cutoff. Bilanzielles EK 2.265,6 Mio. (2024: 4.288,0 Mio.). It fell after the Bilanzgewinn of 2.440,4 Mio. was distributed; 2025 JFB -81,1 Mio., Bilanzgewinn 2025 418,0 Mio. Whether the AT1 (407 Mio.) is shown in balance-sheet EK is unclear. Fonds § 340g not found.

items.notes: Bilanzsumme 49.177 / 52.953 Mio. EUR. EK of 3,593 Mrd. (both years) is from the key figures and excludes nachrangige Verbindlichkeiten and Genussrechte. Including those it is 4.000 / 4.001 Mio. The figures are given in Mrd. with 3 decimals, so precision is 1 Mio. Fonds § 340g not found: the extractable text (DE and EN versions) ends before the Bilanz/Anhang.
